summary: Added the workflow_dispatch release pipeline (.github/workflows/release.yml) and one minimal how-to with sidebar/index/README registrations; all gates my change affects pass. pnpm lint is red ONLY from a pre-existing knip/lefthook finding on main, unrelated to this change.

pre_existing_red_gate.finding: knip reports lefthook as an unused devDependency (package.json:100)
pre_existing_red_gate.proven_pre_existing: Reproduced on the clean base branch HEAD 1a658a0 (current origin/main) with all my changes stashed; introduced by commit 66ff148 'Remove lefthook from knip's ignoreDependencies'. Lives in package.json/knip.json, files this task does not touch. My change adds zero new lint findings.
pre_existing_red_gate.not_fixed_because: Outside this task's scope (release pipeline), and commit 66ff148 removed lefthook deliberately - reverting it would undo an owner decision of unknown intent.
pre_existing_red_gate.consequences_for_owner: CI's lint job on main is currently red for the same reason; and the new release workflow's gate runs pnpm lint, so until this is resolved a release will correctly abort at the gate (requirement #3) and cannot be cut. One-line owner fix in knip.json (re-add lefthook to ignoreDependencies) or remove the unused lefthook devDependency.

details.owner_prerequisite: Create the RELEASE_PAT Actions secret (fine-grained, this repo only, Contents: Read & write, 90-day expiry) before the first real run. Documented in docs/contribution-docs/how-tos/release.md. A dry_run dispatch validates gate + version + notes preview without it.

decisions.summary: Release gate mirrors CI's lint job including the bundled-docs sync check, not just bare pnpm lint
decisions.chosen: lint + docs:bundle sync check + test + build
decisions.reasoning: Exact parity with ci.yml's lint job at negligible cost; research left this open (carried as plan decision D1).

decisions.summary: Register the single guide in the VitePress sidebar and contribution-docs index, and add one additive README Versioning pointer
decisions.chosen: Two one-line registrations in existing files plus one README sentence
decisions.reasoning: Keeps the guide from being an orphaned page and satisfies acceptance criterion 9 (README consistency); owner permitted a one-line pointer 'if needed' (plan decisions D2/D3). The README cross-reference inside the guide uses an absolute GitHub URL because a relative link to the root README is a VitePress dead link (root README is not a built docs page).
